drawings.description: croquis : une droite de base portant trois points, notés \uncertain{$t_1$}, \uncertain{$y_0$} et $\bar{\eta}$ ; au-dessus de chacun une fibre verticale — celle de $t_1$ se recoupe elle-même, celle de $\bar{\eta}$ est hachurée —, et une courbe transverse, marquée $\tilde{z}$, qui les coupe toutes les trois
drawings.kind: fibres over a base line, with a transverse curve
drawings.notes: A base line with three points, labelled t_1, y_0 and bar eta (the first two uncertain, as in the transcription); above each a vertical fibre: that of t_1 drawn as two strokes crossing each other, that of bar eta doubled and hatched with a zigzag (drawn as a zigzag between its two strokes, in pencil); a transverse curve, z tilde, crossing all three near the top. The point over y_0 is a dot on the base line; over bar eta the base line is thickened.
